"""Turn order references in free text into the shop's canonical form.

Support agents want the order references in a customer's message turned into
links; :func:`order_refs` finds them however the customer typed them
("so 2019 123", "SO-2019-000123", "ORD_1A2B3C4D5E6F") and returns each one
written the way the shop writes it ("SO-2019-000123", "ord_1a2b3c4d5e6f").
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re

__all__ = ["order_refs"]

# "SO-2019-000123", "so 2019 123", "b2b-2020-7" ... The kind is the one the
# engine numbers (core.order_engine), the year is four digits and the sequence
# one to six digits (it is zero padded to six in the shop's form).
_NUMBERED_REF_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?P<kind>SO|B2B)[\s-]+(?P<year>\d{4})[\s-]+(?P<seq>\d{1,6})\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
# "ORD_1A2B3C4D5E6F" as typed; the shop writes them lower case (utils.ids.new_id).
_ORDER_ID_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?P<prefix>ord)_(?P<value>[0-9a-f]{12})\b", re.IGNORECASE)

_MIN_YEAR = 1990
_MAX_YEAR = 2100


def order_refs(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Canonical order references mentioned in `text`.

    Returned in the order they first appear, without duplicates. Anything
    that is not a valid order reference (wrong kind, year out of range,
    non-numeric sequence, ...) is left out.
    """
    if not text:
        return []
    found: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
    for m in _NUMBERED_REF_RE.finditer(text):
        year = int(m["year"])
        seq = int(m["seq"])
        if not _MIN_YEAR <= year <= _MAX_YEAR or seq == 0:
            continue
        found.append((m.start(), f"{m['kind'].upper()}-{year:04d}-{seq:06d}"))
    for m in _ORDER_ID_RE.finditer(text):
        found.append((m.start(), f"ord_{m['value'].lower()}"))
    found.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[0])
    refs: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for _, ref in found:
        if ref not in seen:
            seen.add(ref)
            refs.append(ref)
    return refs
